decision: Accepted 2026-11-26 under the stated criteria. (1) Proptest: native/domain/tests/invariants.rs adds 10 properties with fixed seed 0x5152_4c44_0000_0002 and 512 cases each, and failure persistence off. They cover integer units (exact or Overflow, never wrap), daily floor and capacity (exact, floored at zero, monotone in equity and limit), the breach latch against a session model, lots/fees/cash/PnL conservation with refused fills atomic, valuation, and frame length/version checks. Three seeded defects were each caught. (2) Boundary harness: native/python/tests/test_boundary_randomized.py is a bounded randomized test of the six Python-facing native functions, with seed 20261126 and 2000 iterations per function, checked against exact Python integers. It was chosen over cargo-fuzz, which needs a nightly toolchain and an install. A seeded wrapping-add defect was caught. The cdylib was built with cargo, not maturin, and staged outside the shared venv, so the Python tests ran against that build and not a wheel. (3) CI matrix: not applied. Adding a gated job requires editing the existing ci-success aggregator, and no tools/check gate runs cargo. The exact change is in QUALITY-AND-SECURITY_ci_matrix_change.md and includes an explicit import check, because importorskip would otherwise hide a missing module. Corrections: the earlier cargo-audit record covers Cargo.lock f12ec2f4, which NATIVE-DOMAIN replaced with 9174ef47. The committed lock was re-audited here (60 crate dependencies, exit 0). Semantic notes for the NATIVE-DOMAIN owner, with no change made: (a) DailyLossGuard's module doc says every failing method leaves the guard unchanged, but observe_equity sets the latch before a failing capacity computation, and the existing test asserts that. (b) remaining_daily_capacity returns Overflow for a deep breach whose clamped value would be zero, because the intermediate difference leaves i64. Existing tests assert this on purpose. Reproducer: qrl_native.remaining_daily_capacity_cents(9223372036854775799, -9223372036854775801, 1) raises OverflowError. (c) properties.rs uses random seeds and the default case count, so it is not reproducible. The new file supersedes it for the fixed-seed contract without modifying it. Not claimed: any hosted CI result, the aarch64 build, and GH200 runs.
